messages:
Morgan: nightly eval alert — synthetic-seed cohort failing for model redwood-3q int4. lots of very short, cryptic completions instead of full answers. seen across multiple prompts. pinging eng-ml oncall.

eval-bot: ALERT 1723456789: nightly-suite 'natqa-synthetic-seed' failed 23% -> 62% fail rate vs baseline. top symptom=terse/compressed completions. examples attached: `['Q: Who wrote X? A: X.']`

Raj: curious if this is a seed-sensitivity thing from our synthetic augmentation. did the quant run change random seed handling?

Emily: I ran a quick diff against redwood-3q fp16 and int8 nightly: int8 had a bump but not this magnitude. int4 looks worse. attaching tiny repro in DM.

Lin: could be kvcache prefix dropout with our int4 kernels. last deploy included `kv_prefetch` flag flip. worth reverting?

Dave: assigning initial ownership to @Raj for triage. Raj, can you run small-batch repro with `--synthetic-seed=42` and `--batch-size=1` and paste top 5 responses? also capture `--kvcache` on/off.

Raj: on it. running now on a small sample. will post outputs here.

Raj: quick logs: `seed=42 prompt='Who painted the Mona Lisa?' model=redwood-3q-int4 response='Mona Lisa — painted.'` another: `prompt='Explain backprop' response='Backprop — update.'` feels like severe truncation to noun phrases.

Emily: those look systematically clipped mid-sentence. any tokenization differences? tokenizer version?

Raj: tokenizer v2.1 same as baseline. digging into beam/stop token behavior. int4 detokenization maybe mis-handling high byte values.

Lin: recommendation: freeze int4 rollout on hosted and Dedicated autoscale until root cause. low-risk rollback to int8 for dedicated pools serving high-sensitivity cohorts.

Dave: agree. Emily can you open rollback PR for Dedicated autopools? set rollback target and ETA.

Emily: will open PR and start rollback job. ETA ~40m if no blockers. posting job link shortly. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

Raj: found a suspicious underflow in quant kernel when handling attention mask of length 0 in edge cases introduced by synthetic prompts. patching now, will run unit test and small nightly.

Morgan: thanks team. severity updated to P2. keep thread updated with repro, logs, and whether rollback completed. if Raj's patch looks good we can fast-track a canary before full re-rollout. :thumbsup:
